summary:
IWG (International Workplace Group), owner of Regus, Spaces, HQ and Signature, announced a new Regus flexible workspace at Dunscar House in Egerton, near Bolton, opening in H1 2027. The location sits in the West Pennine Moors near Egerton Park with motorway access to Bolton, Blackburn and Greater Manchester, and will offer private offices, meeting rooms, co-working and creative spaces, plus IWG's Design Your Own Office service for tailored fit-out. Target occupiers include manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, retail, construction and professional services firms, from startups to established companies.

The release frames the opening within IWG's wider expansion. The company reports its highest-ever revenue, cashflow and earnings growth, having signed a record 728 new locations globally in H1 2026, bringing its network past 6,000 signed locations in more than 120 countries. Growth is described as capital-light: 95% of those new locations come via managed partnership agreements, which IWG says let property owners raise returns on their buildings while IWG scales quickly. In 2025 IWG signed 1,132 locations, 99% partnership deals.

Supporting claims cover hybrid working benefits: academic research cited for work-life balance, financial and health gains for workers and productivity, cost savings and engagement for employers; IWG and Arup research putting a productivity boost at 11%; hybrid working potentially adding up to 46 billion pounds in GVA to the UK economy annually by 2045, equivalent to the city of Leeds; average employer saving of 9,000 pounds per employee; and a prediction that 30% of commercial real estate will be flexible workspace by 2030. IWG cites 1.2 billion white collar workers globally and a total addressable market above 1.57 trillion pounds, with 83% of Fortune 500 companies as customers.

Quotes come from IWG PLC CEO Christian Schmitz and Piotr Szydlik, Managing Director of landlord partner Sampira Group, who links the deal to strengthening Deakins Business Park. This is a vendor press release rather than independent reporting.
